messages:
tara: Heads-up — customer reported a spike on their invoice where token usage doubled for a 10m window last night. Can ops take a look?

nina: Support saw the ticket. Customer claims 24k tokens billed but their app reported 12k generated. They included sample request ids.

ben: Looking at runtime traces now. I see a flurry of 429 retries from the frontend at 03:41:10Z -> 03:41:28Z. Retries were client-side with exponential backoff disabled (bug). We normally dedupe on server request-id but many requests lacked id header.

lee: Oof. If requests retried without idempotency key and the billing pipeline counted each successful response, that could double count. Any idea how many succ responses?

ben: Quick grep shows ~1,142 unique request bodies in that window, but ~2,289 responses recorded in billing events — delta ~1,147.

tara: Rough cost exposure? This is a high-touch customer on committed plan but they get overages too. Finance needs numbers for adjustment.

lee: Average tokens per request from sample ~210. Delta tokens ~= 1,147 * 210 = 240,870 tokens. Current per-token billable unit is per 1k tokens at $0.02 -> so cost = (240.87 * 0.02) = $4.82.

ben: Also confirm duplicate-response path: runtime returns 200 and writes event to kafka billing-topic on success. No dedupe there. Billing aggregator increments counters on each event.

nina: Customer asks for immediate credit. They provided request timestamps and request bodies.

tara: Approve a one-time invoice credit up to $25 pending root cause and fix. Please document in the invoice note and tag FIN-2026-304.

billing-bot: Creating ticket FIN-2026-304. Tagging invoices window 2026-03-23T03:40:00Z -> 2026-03-23T03:45:00Z and auto-drafting credit memo for $4.82.

lee: Action items: (1) deploy runtime patch to require idempotency-key header and reject/mirror missing ones to a quarantine stream, (2) add billing-aggregator dedupe by request fingerprint for 5m TTL, (3) add support playbook to detect client retry storms.

ben: I'll push hotfix to reject duplicate requests without idempotency header and add metrics alert when duplicate ratio > 1.2 within 1m.

nina: I'll communicate back to customer and attach the credit memo once billing-bot finalizes.

tara: Keep finance looped. Also schedule a postmortem and include recommended invoice template language about transient retry credits.

lee: Noted. Will include code refs and telemetry graphs in postmortem.

ben: Deploying fix to canary now. Will report back once aggregator dedupe implemented. :rocket:
